concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-010 (loss‑per‑epoch logging, ΔL computation, plateau detection) is not addressed in any phase. The plan only logs accuracy, RAM, and wall‑clock time, violating the spec.

The plan validates results only against `contracts/experiment_results.schema.yaml` but never references or exercises `contracts/experiment.schema.yaml`, which defines additional fields (variance_explained, k_selected, etc.). This disconnect violates the Plan ↔ contracts consistency check.

Loss‑landscape metrics required by FR-010 (per‑epoch loss values, ΔL, plateau epoch) are not logged nor stored in `state.yaml`. Without these logs the downstream analysis and contract validation cannot be performed.
